purpose: Ambitious ML phase: decision-aware, uncertainty-aware multi-sleeve allocator

training_design.label_purging: train cut-off is current date minus 4 weeks to avoid overlap with forward 4-week labels
training_design.decision_target: cross-sectionally ranked forward sleeve utility penalized for downside, realized volatility, drawdown, tail mean, and fragile offensive exposure
training_design.tail_target: more conservative utility with heavier left-tail penalties
training_design.uncertainty_model: quantile interval width + model disagreement + classifier entropy
training_design.moe_design: three linear experts (calm, recovery, defense) blended by a learned multinomial gate on date-level features
